comment: Registry components intentionally without a design-card fixture. Anything missing a fixture that is NOT listed here fails design:validate, forcing fixtures and registry to stay in lockstep. The pattern slugs below are the declared PATTERN_ADAPTER_PENDING roster in src/app/(docs)/patterns/[group]/[pattern]/pattern-preview-fixtures.tsx: the design system exports each one, but the showroom cannot feed it a truthful payload yet, so it harvests as no-fixture rather than photographing a placeholder card and counting it valid. Removing a slug here is the same change that lands its real adapter.
